au.csiro.JamesGunning.sulib
Class SuSegyFormat

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--au.csiro.JamesGunning.sulib.SuSegyFormat
public class SuSegyFormat
extends java.lang.Object

Class containing storage, getters, and setters for seismic data in Big endian (java-native) su (clean segy) format. The header format follows the header file segy.h in the SeismicUnix distribution from the Colorado School of Mines. The XDR (platform-independent format) option is not currently supported

Objects in this class have data in su format, stored natively as one copy in byte[] arrays for efficiency. The byte arrays will correspond to big endian seismic data.

The get_xxx(String key) and put_xxx(String key, value) are getters and setters of the named header fields

Looping over header fields is best accomplished using a Collection formed from the HashMap of the header fields. See SuRange for an example

data from the data part of the traces is available from the calls get_data_value(indx) and get_data_array()

data from the data part of the traces may be set by the calls set_data_value(float datum, int indx) and set_data_array(float data[])

Header fields and their meanings

tracl
int tracl; trace sequence number within line
Use get_int("tracl") and put("tracl",value)

tracr
int tracr; trace sequence number within reel
Use get_int("tracr") and put("tracr",value)

fldr
int fldr; field record number
Use get_int("fldr") and put("fldr",value)

tracf
int tracf; trace number within field record
Use get_int("tracf") and put("tracf",value)

ep
int ep; energy source point number
Use get_int("ep") and put("ep",value)

cdp
int cdp; CDP ensemble number Use get_int("cdp") and put("cdp",value)

cdpt
int cdpt; trace number within CDP ensemble
Use get_int("cdpt") and put("cdpt",value)

trid
short trid; trace identification code:
1 = seismic data
2 = dead
3 = dummy
4 = time break
5 = uphole
6 = sweep
7 = timing
8 = water break
9---, N = optional use (N = 32,767)
Following are CWP id flags:
9 = autocorrelation
10 = Fourier transformed - no packing
xr[0],xi[0], ..., xr[N-1],xi[N-1]
11 = Fourier transformed - unpacked Nyquist
xr[0],xi[0],...,xr[N/2],xi[N/2]
12 = Fourier transformed - packed Nyquist
even N:
xr[0],xr[N/2],xr[1],xi[1], ...,
xr[N/2 -1],xi[N/2 -1]
(note the exceptional second entry)
odd N:
xr[0],xr[(N-1)/2],xr[1],xi[1], ...,
xr[(N-1)/2 -1],xi[(N-1)/2 -1],xi[(N-1)/2]
(note the exceptional second & last entries)
13 = Complex signal in the time domain
xr[0],xi[0], ..., xr[N-1],xi[N-1]
14 = Fourier transformed - amplitude/phase
a[0],p[0], ..., a[N-1],p[N-1]
15 = Complex time signal - amplitude/phase
a[0],p[0], ..., a[N-1],p[N-1]
16 = Real part of complex trace from 0 to Nyquist
17 = Imag part of complex trace from 0 to Nyquist
18 = Amplitude of complex trace from 0 to Nyquist
19 = Phase of complex trace from 0 to Nyquist
21 = Wavenumber time domain (k-t)
22 = Wavenumber frequency (k-omega)
23 = Envelope of the complex time trace
24 = Phase of the complex time trace
25 = Frequency of the complex time trace
30 = Depth-Range (z-x) traces
43 = Seismic Data, Vertical Component
44 = Seismic Data, Horizontal Component 1
45 = Seismic Data, Horizontal Component 2
46 = Seismic Data, Radial Component
47 = Seismic Data, Transverse Component
101 = Seismic data packed to bytes (by supack1)
102 = Seismic data packed to 2 bytes (by supack2)
Use get_short("trid") and put("trid",value)

nvs
short nvs; number of vertically summed traces (see vscode in bhed structure)
Use get_short("nvs") and put("nvs",value)

nhs
short nhs; number of horizontally summed traces (see vscode in bhed structure)
Use get_short("nhs") and put("nhs",value)

duse
short duse data use: 1 = production, 2 = test
Use get_short("duse") and put("duse",value)

offset
int offset; distance from source point to receiver group
(negative if opposite to direction in which the line was shot)
Use get_int("offset") and put("offset",value)

gelev
int gelev; receiver group elevation from sea level
(above sea level is positive)
Use get_int("gelev") and put("gelev",value)

selev
int selev; source elevation from sea level
(above sea level is positive)
Use get_int("selev") and put("selev",value)

sdepth
int sdepth; source depth (positive)
Use get_int("sdepth") and put("sdepth",value)

gdel
int gdel; datum elevation at receiver group
Use get_int("gdel") and put("gdel",value)

sdel
datum elevation at source
Use get_int("sdel") and put("sdel",value)

swdep
water depth at source
Use get_int("swdep") and put("swdep",value)

gwdep
water depth at receiver group
Use get_int("gwdep") and put("gwdep",value)

scalel
scale factor for previous 7 entries
with value plus or minus 10 to the power 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4 (if positive, multiply, if negative divide)
Use get_short("scalel") and put("scalel",value)

scalco
scale factor for next 4 entries with value plus or minus 10 to the power 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4 (if positive, multiply, if negative divide)
Use get_short("scalco") and put("scalco",value)

sx
X source coordinate
Use get_int("sx") and put("sx",value)

sy
Y source coordinate
Use get_int("sy") and put("sy",value)

gx
X group coordinate
Use get_int("gx") and put("gx",value)

gy
Y group coordinate
Use get_int("gy") and put("gy",value)

counit
coordinate units code: for previous four entries
1 = length (meters or feet)
2 = seconds of arc (in this case, the
X values are longitude and the Y values are latitude, a positive value designates the number of seconds east of Greenwich or north of the equator
Use get_short("counit") and put("counit",value)

wevel
weathering velocity
Use get_short("wevel") and put("wevel",value)

swevel
subweathering velocity
Use get_short("swevel") and put("swevel",value)

sut
uphole time at source
Use get_short("sut") and put("sut",value)

gut
uphole time at receiver group
Use get_short("gut") and put("gut",value)

sstat
source static correction
Use get_short("sstat") and put("sstat",value)

gstat
group static correction
Use get_short("gstat") and put("gstat",value)

tstat
total static applied
Use get_short("tstat") and put("tstat",value)

laga
lag time A, time in ms between end of 240- byte trace identification header and time break, positive if time break occurs after end of header, time break is defined as the initiation pulse which maybe recorded on an auxiliary trace or as otherwise specified by the recording system
Use get_short("laga") and put("laga",value)

lagb
lag time B, time in ms between the time break and the initiation time of the energy source, may be positive or negative
Use get_short("lagb") and put("lagb",value)

delrt
delay recording time, time in ms between initiation time of energy source and time when recording of data samples begins (for deep water work if recording does not start at zero time)
Use get_short("delrt") and put("delrt",value)

muts
mute time--start
Use get_short("muts") and put("muts",value)

mute
mute time--end
Use get_short("mute") and put("mute",value)

ns
number of samples in this trace
Use get_short("ns") and put("ns",value)

dt
sample interval in micro-seconds
get_short("dt");

gain
gain type of field instruments code:
1 = fixed
2 = binary
3 = floating point
4 ---- N = optional use
Use get_short("gain") and put("gain",value)

igc
instrument gain constant
Use get_short("igc") and put("igc",value)

igi
instrument early or initial gain
Use get_short("igi") and put("igi",value)

corr
correlated:
1 = no
2 = yes
Use get_short("corr") and put("corr",value)

sfs
sweep frequency at start
Use get_short("sfs") and put("sfs",value)

sfe
sweep frequency at end
Use get_short("sfe") and put("sfe",value)

slen
sweep length in ms
Use get_short("slen") and put("slen",value)

styp
sweep type code:
1 = linear
2 = cos-squared
3 = other
Use get_short("styp") and put("styp",value)

stas
sweep trace length at start in ms
Use get_short("stas") and put("stas",value)

stae
sweep trace length at end in ms
Use get_short("stae") and put("stae",value)

tatyp
taper type: 1=linear, 2=cos^2, 3=other
Use get_short("tatyp") and put("tatyp",value)

afilf
alias filter frequency if used
Use get_short("afilf") and put("afilf",value)

afils
alias filter slope
Use get_short("afils") and put("afils",value)

nofilf
notch filter frequency if used
Use get_short("nofilf") and put("nofilf",value)

nofils
notch filter slope
Use get_short("nofils") and put("nofils",value)

lcf
low cut frequency if used
Use get_short("lcf") and put("lcf",value)

hcf
high cut frequncy if used
Use get_short("hcf") and put("hcf",value)

lcs
low cut slope
Use get_short("lcs") and put("lcs",value)

hcs
high cut slope
Use get_short("hcs") and put("hcs",value)

year
year data recorded
Use get_short("year") and put("year",value)

day
day of year
Use get_short("day") and put("day",value)

hour
hour of day (24 hour clock)
Use get_short("hour") and put("hour",value)

minute
minute of hour
Use get_short("minute") and put("minute",value)

sec
second of minute
Use get_short("sec") and put("sec",value)

timbas
time basis code:
1 = local
2 = GMT
3 = other
Use get_short("timbas") and put("timbas",value)

trwf
trace weighting factor, defined as 1/2^N volts for the least sigificant bit
Use get_short("trwf") and put("trwf",value)

grnors
geophone group number of roll switch position one
Use get_short("grnors") and put("grnors",value)

grnofr
geophone group number of trace one within original field record
Use get_short("grnofr") and put("grnofr",value)

grnlof
geophone group number of last trace within original field record
Use get_short("grnlof") and put("grnlof",value)

gaps
gap size (total number of groups dropped)
Use get_short("gaps") and put("gaps",value)

otrav
overtravel taper code:
1 = down (or behind)
2 = up (or ahead)
Use get_short("otrav") and put("otrav",value)

local assignments:

d1
sample spacing for non-seismic data
Use get_float("d1") and put("d1",value)

f1
first sample location for non-seismic data
Use get_float("f1") and put("f1",value)

d2
sample spacing between traces
Use get_float("d2") and put("d2",value)

f2
first trace location
Use get_float("f2") and put("f2",value)

ungpow
negative of power used for dynamic range compression
Use get_float("ungpow") and put("ungpow",value)

unscale
reciprocal of scaling factor to normalize range
Use get_float("unscale") and put("unscale",value)

ntr
number of traces
Use get_int("ntr") and put("ntr",value)

mark
mark selected traces
Use get_short("mark") and put("mark",value)

shortpad
alignment padding
Use get_short("shortpad") and put("shortpad",value)

Bits in Segy.h which aren't needed...
short unass[14];
unassigned--NOTE: last entry causes a break in the word alignment, if we REALLY want to maintain 240 bytes, the following entry should be an odd number of short/UINT2 OR do the insertion above the "mark" keyword entry

headerMap

public java.util.HashMap headerMap
A hashmap of all header fields created with setupHeaderMap() (private) at each object instantiation. It is always available for checking validity of keywords etc. The key is the header field name (String), and the values are instances of SuHeaderEntry (header name (String), SuHeadTypes, byte_location)

set_data_array

public void set_data_array(float[] data)
Convert the float array into bytes in the data part of the trace, with no offsets. Virtually a data dump. The data is dumped for indices i=0...n, with n = min(ns,data.length) (ns = no. samples in trace)

Parameters:
data - = array of floats.
